params.prompt: macOS app icon for an app called Glowbeat, a Mac app that makes smart light bulbs pulse to music. Apple macOS Sonoma icon style: a single rounded-square (squircle) tile with soft top-lit glassy gradient, subtle inner shadow, centered on a plain solid dark gray background with nothing else, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border, front view, ultra clean vector-like rendering, high detail. The tile is a black-to-purple gradient. Inside: a minimalist glowing bulb outline in white neon, with a single bright ring pulse behind it in gradient pink to cyan, cinematic bloom, premium and simple.
